skill.name: ai-product
skill.description: Guidance for building production AI product features, including LLM integration patterns, RAG architecture, prompt testing, AI UX trust, safety validation, and cost control.
skill.summary: Guides production-ready LLM features with validation, testing, RAG design, user trust, and cost controls.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: I reviewed the prompt-only SKILL.md and found no static findings to adjudicate. The content provides AI product engineering guidance and does not include code, filesystem access, network calls, or prompt-injection instructions. No semantic abuse or data-exfiltration intent was found.

content.value_statement: AI features often fail when prompts, retrieval, costs, and safety are treated as afterthoughts. This skill guides production patterns for reliable LLM features.
actual_capabilities: Guides use of function calling or JSON mode with schema validation.
Recommends streaming responses to reduce perceived latency.
Encourages prompt versioning and regression testing.
Identifies risks from unvalidated LLM output and unsanitized prompt input.
Highlights API cost monitoring, failure handling, and factual validation.
limitations: Does not provide executable code, scripts, or automation.
Does not implement a full RAG stack or evaluation harness.
Requires adaptation to each model provider and product constraint.
Does not replace security, privacy, or legal review for production AI systems.

use_cases.title: Design Reliable LLM Features
use_cases.description: Plan validation, streaming, fallbacks, and monitoring before an AI feature reaches users.

use_cases.title: Review AI Architecture Risks
use_cases.description: Check product plans for prompt injection, hallucination, cost, latency, and outage risks.

use_cases.title: Plan Trustworthy AI Experiences
use_cases.description: Shape AI UX around clear progress, confidence, citations, and user control.

prompt_templates.title: Review Feature Readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review for an early AI feature idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my AI feature concept for production readiness. Focus on validation, latency, cost, failure handling, and user trust. Ask clarifying questions first.

prompt_templates.title: Plan LLM Integration
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for a defined product feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an LLM integration plan for [feature]. Include structured outputs, prompt versioning, streaming UX, fallback behavior, and monitoring.

prompt_templates.title: Design RAG Architecture
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced architecture work for knowledge-grounded answers.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a RAG architecture for [domain]. Include retrieval strategy, context limits, citation handling, evaluation metrics, and safety checks.

prompt_templates.title: Audit AI Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced risk review before launch or major changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this AI workflow for prompt injection, unvalidated outputs, cost spikes, hallucination risk, and outage handling. Prioritize fixes by severity.

output_examples.input: I need a support assistant that answers from our help center.
output_examples.output: A production plan covering retrieval scope, answer validation, citations, streaming responses, fallback copy, monitoring, and escalation paths.

output_examples.input: Our LLM feature returns inconsistent formats.
output_examples.output: A recommendation to use structured output, schema validation, prompt regression tests, and clear failure handling for invalid responses.

output_examples.input: We want to reduce model costs without hurting quality.
output_examples.output: A cost review covering context limits, model selection, caching, request monitoring, and quality checks before rollout.

best_practices: Treat prompts as versioned product code with tests.
Validate model outputs before using them in product logic.
Monitor latency, cost, quality, and fallback behavior after launch.
anti_patterns: Shipping a demo without error handling, monitoring, or safety checks.
Stuffing every available document into the context window.
Parsing free-form model text as if it were stable data.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps design production AI product features that use LLMs, retrieval, validation, testing, and monitoring.

faq.question: Does it include executable code?
faq.answer: No. It is a prompt-only guidance skill with product and engineering patterns.

faq.question: Can it help with RAG systems?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers retrieval strategy, context limits, citations, factual checks, and evaluation concerns.

faq.question: Can it improve AI user experience?
faq.answer: Yes. It highlights streaming, progress feedback, trust signals, fallback states, and user control.

faq.question: Is it suitable for production reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide checks for cost, safety, latency, hallucination, and failure handling.

faq.question: Does it replace expert security review?
faq.answer: No. Use it as planning guidance, then complete normal security, privacy, and compliance reviews.
